captures.query:
BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s';
SET LOCAL lock_timeout='500ms';
SET LOCAL application_name='ce1_ce101_inventory';
WITH trigger_inventory AS (
 SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS relation,t.tgname AS name,t.tgenabled AS enabled,t.tgtype,
 fn.nspname AS function_schema,p.proname AS function_name,t.tgnargs AS argument_count,
 md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS function_definition_md5,
 (p.proname='http_request' OR pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) ~ 'net[.]http_(post|get)|extensions[.]http') AS direct_http_indicator
 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND n.nspname IN ('public','auth','storage','comparator_internal','price_alerts_internal')
), grouped_triggers AS (
 SELECT function_schema,function_name,enabled,direct_http_indicator,function_definition_md5,
 count(*) AS trigger_count,array_agg(DISTINCT schema||'.'||relation ORDER BY schema||'.'||relation) AS relations
 FROM trigger_inventory GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
), queue_access AS (
 SELECT c.relname AS name,c.relrowsecurity AS rls,
 has_schema_privilege('anon',n.oid,'USAGE') AS anon_schema_usage,
 has_schema_privilege('authenticated',n.oid,'USAGE') AS authenticated_schema_usage,
 has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'SELECT') AS anon_select,
 has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'SELECT') AS authenticated_select,
 has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') AS anon_any_write,
 has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') AS authenticated_any_write
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE n.nspname='pgmq' AND c.relkind='r' AND c.relname IN('meta','q_catalog_embedding_jobs','a_catalog_embedding_jobs')
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',clock_timestamp(),
 'storage_buckets',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'public',public,'file_size_limit',file_size_limit,'allowed_mime_types',allowed_mime_types) ORDER BY id) FROM storage.buckets),
 'storage_policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',policyname,'relation',tablename,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'permissive',permissive,'using_md5',md5(qual),'check_md5',md5(with_check),'using_auth_uid',coalesce(qual LIKE '%auth.uid()% ',false) OR coalesce(qual LIKE '%auth.uid()%',false),'check_auth_uid',coalesce(with_check LIKE '%auth.uid()%',false)) ORDER BY tablename,policyname) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='storage'),
 'cron_jobs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',jobid,'name',jobname,'schedule',schedule,'active',active,'database',database,'username',username,'command_md5',md5(command),'http_call_indicator',command ~ 'net[.]http_(post|get)','function_routes',regexp_matches_safe.routes) ORDER BY jobid) FROM cron.job LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(m[1]) AS routes FROM regexp_matches(command,'https?://[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+/functions/v1/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+','g')m)regexp_matches_safe ON true),
 'queues',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',queue_name,'partitioned',is_partitioned,'unlogged',is_unlogged,'created_at',created_at) ORDER BY queue_name) FROM pgmq.meta),
 'queue_access',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY name) FROM queue_access q),
 'trigger_function_groups',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY function_schema,function_name) FROM grouped_triggers g),
 'http_trigger_candidates',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY schema,relation,name) FROM trigger_inventory t WHERE direct_http_indicator),
 'pipeline_mode',(SELECT mode FROM comparator_internal.catalog_embedding_pipeline_control LIMIT 1)
) AS evidence;
ROLLBACK;

edge_auth_source_review.guard: Nonempty EMBEDDING_WORKER_TOKEN compared with X-Embedding-Worker-Token using double-HMAC before job processing; withSupabase auth:none.
Nonempty RC_WEBHOOK_TOKEN compared with Authorization using double-HMAC before service-role profile update.

dashboard.method: Authenticated dashboard through accessibility tree; exposed-schema checkmarks verified by screenshot; no save/toggle/apply.

auth_hooks.distinction: SQL trigger on_auth_user_created remains present; Auth Hooks UI is a different mechanism.

findings.finding: Automatic exposure of new tables enabled. Private-schema naming alone is not a full privilege boundary.
Embedding dispatcher paused does not pause price-alert cron or catalog triggers; never seed fake products in published catalogs.
Both existing Storage buckets public; no CE-1 private evidence/test dataset should be placed there.
Auth Site URL remains localhost and broad Expo/custom-scheme redirects coexist in shared project. Native PKCE callback is allowlisted; fallback/deep-link behavior requires scoped runtime validation.

Nominated profile has exactly one match; username existence is not authenticated ownership or immutable authorization. Future server allowlist must bind verified auth.uid, remain deny-by-default, preserve CU-01 and not rely on client flags.

No direct-HTTP trigger candidates found by bounded name/body heuristic; not a transitive call-graph or external delivery audit. RevenueCat receiver/source verified, provider configuration and secret presence not verified.
Storage avatar policies have semantic duplicates; missing explicit WITH CHECK on an UPDATE is not alone a hole because USING supplies it. Do not alter global policies by carryover.
Price-alert worker permits embedding-secret fallback. Verify dedicated secret presence before any future separation; no rotation/configuration change authorized here.

limitations: No test feature access activated or enforcement implemented
